_comment: Set player_faction to SOVIET or AXIS to choose which side you play. The roster's units are tagged with which faction they belong to - the generator automatically spawns whichever faction is NOT player_faction as the enemy. class/task values must be real, verified class names - do not invent new ones here, the generator will refuse to run with an unknown class/task/player unit.
_axis_player_note: CTankPzVIAusfEUnit (the Tiger) has known cosmetic-only issues from earlier this session - a few interior animations (gun-laying needles, commander hatch, some gauges) don't play due to a 3D model gap, documented in the docs repo CHANGELOG. Doesn't affect driving, aiming, or firing. Set AXIS player_unit_class to CTankPzIVGUnit instead if you'd rather avoid that entirely.
